protocol.selection: Train-Dev R@1/20m, then lowest NE, earliest tied epoch; no Val-Seen/Unseen/Test selection
protocol.training_order: same seed and epoch -> same torch.Generator permutation over Train-Fit; same per-epoch dropout RNG seed; matching random initialization across representations/scopes
protocol.loss: existing cross_entropy_goal Gaussian spatial target, unchanged default sigma_cells=0.9
protocol.shared_full_note: Full Polygon inputs are identical in both scopes with GAT disabled, hence one trained run per seed is reused by byte-identical checkpoint SHA; 18 logical conditions,15 unique runs.
protocol.feature_center: original arithmetic vertex mean, including source closing vertex; shared same point across all representations, even when it is not the AABB center
protocol.road_policy: verified open line: never close. Centroid/BBox unavailable line boundary/inside masked; near/along fall back to available point. TrafficRoad source areas remain polygons. Actual dataset max_roads=0; counts audited.

groups.irregular: any valid polygon area/minimum_rotated_rectangle_area < .85; otherwise regular
groups.elongated: any valid polygon minimum_rotated_rectangle aspect >=3; otherwise compact
groups.large: max valid surface polygon area >1000m^2; otherwise small
groups.road_like: verified open polyline OR TrafficRoad surface, original type preserved
groups.landmark_count: distinct canonical referenced names; ambiguous same-name fragments not counted as distinct names
groups.relations: only explicitly parsed, uniquely bound named anchor groups; >=2 for multiple; not GT relational annotations
groups.overlapping: type flags may overlap in multi-landmark queries; report N separately; invalid shapes marked unknown, never dropped from overall metrics

navigation.observations: geometry/pose-only policy; no RGB branch. Original rollout and controller reused. Pose-only rendering optimization requires exact Seen128 trajectory parity first.

bootstrap.cluster: map_name; retain all queries/episodes per sampled map
bootstrap.seed_summary: mean and sample std(ddof=1); seed-averaged per-sample effects, fixed seed set; seeds are not extra independent maps

protocol.pre_result_addendum: Before any new evaluation: add frozen prior/rules/node path-to-centroid interventions to separate Polygon bypass dependence; no tuning or architecture change.
protocol.candidate_position: Common absolute 28x28 lattice; relative_position=False, no landmark-dependent positional encoding
protocol.shuffle: Fixed 20261017 permutation of entire spatial bundles within split/TrainDev partition/map/entity-mask/node-type schema; names/language stay recipient. Singleton strata remain unchanged and are reported. Exact spatial marginals, including rule fields, retained; tests spatial grounding jointly, not only landmark-name binding.
protocol.distance: unsigned centroid Euclidean distance only, pair channel2; no signed boundary/inside/extent
protocol.direction: unit centroid-to-candidate vector only, pair channels3,4; no dx/dy magnitude
protocol.all_geometry_baseline: Correct retains all original geometry paths; simple arms zero every other spatial path. This tests total geometry utility, not just pair descriptors.
protocol.navigation_decision: After all static results: evaluate all five new arms, all three seeds on Seen128/Unseen128 then full splits regardless of outcome; fixed transfer head. Correct reuses archived identical arm.

bootstrap: 10000 paired draws seed20261017; seed-mean deltas, not pooled seeds as independent maps

visual_input_plan.geometry_pose: Zero projected current/history RGB-text products and native appearance scores; keep static geometry-language context, static logits, pose distance and common visibility/ROI quality metadata.
visual_input_plan.rgb_text: Zero geometric-language candidate context, static logits/probability and explicit pose distance; retain RGB/text and common visibility/quality metadata.
visual_input_plan.current_rgb: Disable history consistently including features, validity, quality and native fusion.
visual_input_plan.limitation: These are residual descriptor subsets on the SAME frozen geometric base and common observation support. Not strict map-free or sensor-free complete-system baselines.
visual_input_plan.selection: No training/model selection or threshold tuning; established checkpoint and thresholds fixed before new held-out inference
